title: Wednesday Night Jam Session @ The Prophet Bar
event_description: RC & The Gritz lead this legendary weekly jam session featuring funk R&B soul jazz hip hop rock and pop. DJ Jay Clipp spins during breaks. Special guest performers from Erykah Badu's band and national touring artists frequently join.
hosts: RC & The Gritz DJ Jay Clipp
event_venue_information:
The Prophet Bar

Deep Ellum institution featuring two rooms for live music. The Wednesday Night Jam Session is Dallas's best-kept secret where musicians of all levels can perform with RC & The Gritz a band that has toured with Erykah Badu for over 10 years. National touring artists frequently stop by including Common's backing band Bilal Raheem DeVaughn and Bun B. Starting at $10 cover.

Other Events

Live music Wednesday through Saturday with national and local touring bands. All-ages venue until 9 PM then 21+.

title: Tuesday Night Jazz Jam @ Sandaga 813
event_description: Weekly open jam session with world-class jazz musicians. The house band welcomes all instrumentalists and vocalists. Erykah Badu's band RC & The Gritz perform regularly. BBQ available on the patio from Triple D BBQ vendor.
event_venue_information:
Sandaga 813

Jazz and blues lounge located near Fair Park in South Dallas. Known for intimate atmosphere with live band inside and DJ on outdoor patio. Age limit: 25+ women 30+ men creating a mature grown and sexy vibe. $10 cover most nights.

Weekly Schedule

Tuesday: Jazz Jam | Thursday: Live Jazz/Soul | Friday: Hip Hop & R&B DJs | Saturday: Live Soul Music | Sunday: RC & The Gritz

title: Saturday Open Mic @ Opening Bell Coffee
event_description: DFW's longest-running open mic since 2005. Acoustic and keyboard performers play 2 songs or 10 minutes. Prefers original material but allows some covers. All-ages family-friendly event. No backing tracks or explicit language. Sign up at 4 PM first come first served.
backline: Yes - Professional sound system Allen & Heath board monitors mics
sign_up: Yes - Sign up at venue starting 4 PM
event_venue_information:
Opening Bell Coffee

Dallas's premier acoustic music venue and coffee bar in the historic Sears Building basement. Features professional sound system and intimate stage that has hosted Leon Bridges Charley Crockett and artists who went on to The Voice and American Idol. Named one of 2018's 35 Best Folk Music Venues in the US.

Other Events

Live music Thursday-Saturday with local and national touring acts. Coffee beer wine and full menu available. Free WiFi and comfortable seating perfect for studying or working.

title: Songwriters Social @ Adair's Saloon
event_description: Weekly open mic for songwriters hosted by Justin Pickard with Jacob Zazz and Shana Faulhaber. Country-leaning but welcomes all genres. Dive bar atmosphere with famous burgers. Happy hour all day. Kitchen open until 1:30 AM.
hosts: Justin Pickard Jacob Zazz Shana Faulhaber
event_venue_information:
Adair's Saloon

Established 1963. Deep Ellum's authentic honky tonk with dive bar character. Live country music six nights per week. Famous for legendary burgers and wings at reasonable prices. Walls covered with signatures from decades of patrons. Under-21 allowed until 9 PM then becomes 21+.

Atmosphere

Classic American bar with outlaw country vibe. Shuffleboard and Golden Tee. Country dancing. Best burgers in Deep Ellum according to locals.

title: Black Canvas Vibe Out Thursdays @ The Island Spot
event_description: Open mic for Black artists featuring music poetry singers and stand-up comedy. Hosted by Kevin the Singer (Kevin Williams). House band Celestial Clockwork (Grammy-nominated musicians) backs performers. Food drinks and hookah available. Safe space celebrating Black artistic excellence.
event_venue_information:
The Island Spot

Black-owned establishment in Oak Cliff hosting Dallas Black Canvas events. Created by Cameron Johnson and Princess Whittington to provide authentic space for African-American artists. Longest running Thursday night live music space in Dallas spanning 8 years. Features live band inside plus outdoor area.

Black Canvas

Musical collective with 10.6K+ Instagram followers. Residency program 'The Spotlight' features three artists in jam session format. Hater-free environment celebrating Black creativity.

title: Open Mic Night @ Dallas Central Library
event_description: Free monthly open mic for all performers: singers dancers poets magicians instrumentalists and more. Hosted in the Division of Arts Movies and Music. Family-friendly all-ages event. No cover no requirements just show up sign up and perform.
event_venue_information:
Dallas Central Library

Downtown Dallas's main library featuring the Division of Arts Movies and Music on the 5th floor. Free public programs and events. Beautiful modern facility with extensive collection and community programming.

Other Events

Author readings film screenings art exhibitions and educational programs throughout the month. Free and open to the public.
